financial_accounts_days_check.name: financial_accounts_days_check
financial_accounts_days_check.value: ("financial_accounts"."closing_day" is null or "financial_accounts"."closing_day" between 1 and 31) and ("financial_accounts"."due_day" is null or "financial_accounts"."due_day" between 1 and 31)

financial_accounts_type_fields_check.name: financial_accounts_type_fields_check
financial_accounts_type_fields_check.value:
("financial_accounts"."type" = 'credit_card' and "financial_accounts"."closing_day" is not null and "financial_accounts"."due_day" is not null)
        or ("financial_accounts"."type" <> 'credit_card' and "financial_accounts"."opening_balance_date" is not null)
